chants.vernacular_text: Let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice; seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek his face for evermore. ℣. Give thanks to the Lord and call upon his name; declare his deeds among the gentiles.
One thing have I asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord. ℣. To gaze in delight upon the Lord's beauty, and to be sheltered in his holy temple.
The righteous cried out for help, and the Lord heard them; and he delivered them out of all their troubles. ℣. The Lord is near to the broken-hearted and he shall save the contrite in spirit.
Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion.
O Lord, grant me life according to your word, so that I may learn your commandments.
We shall rejoice in your salvation; and in the name of the Lord our God shall we place our pride.
